title: How I Built This Portfolio with Next.js
content: This portfolio runs on the Next.js App Router. Every route is a folder, the two project pages come from one dynamic [slug] template, and the contact forms share a single validation and storage layer in lib/. The server form uses a Server Action, while the API form posts to a route handler — and both write to the same JSON file.

title: From Python Notebook to Production API
content: Turning my Payactiv practicum work into a deployed service taught me the difference between a model that works and a model that serves. Pickled scikit-learn estimators became a documented REST API with a Procfile for cloud deployment, and an MCP server lets AI tools call the predictions directly.
